name: new_v1_family_cross_user_force_intensity_extension_v1
source_fit: F0v2 Rest thresholds and new-v1 metadata on Ramp source subjects 1-6 only; source-trial StandardScaler and class-balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924, exactly the frozen parent training algorithm.
aggregation: Mean over at most eight disjoint native 200 ms windows per trial, exactly matching the parent native-trial screen.
selection: Maximize pooled validation-user macro-F1; tie break by lower validation log loss. Final users 9-10 cannot tune or select models; their previously inspected outcomes are descriptive.
scope: Four independent eight-channel new-v1 family formulas added one at a time to F0v2 on public 1000 Hz LibEMG instructed intensity conditions. Conditions are not measured mechanical force; no own-device 250 Hz live claim.
